_metadata.description: OT-P0-001 — structured plan + phase record persisted to a durable, scenario-independent home store.

requirements.title: A plan is a first-class structured record with ordered first-class phases
requirements.description: A plan is stored as a structured record (meta + global sections + ordered phases; each phase owns its required-reading, reminders, baseline scope, acceptance, and status) and exposes CRUD plus a rendered markdown view. Persistence is rooted at the scenario-independent ~/.vrooli home store so plans remain readable when the plan-manager server is down.

validation.notes: API: plan + phase round-trips through the repository; markdown render is deterministic; target api/internal/plans.
Store roots at the home store path and reads succeed without the server process; target api/internal/plans storage seam.
CLI: plan create/show/list shape over the durable store; target cli/domains/plans.

requirements.title: Phase status is a computed runtime transition, never agent-edited markdown
requirements.description: Phase status (todo / active / done / blocked) changes only through a typed state transition (or inference from acceptance/validation passing). The rendered markdown view reflects status but is never the source of truth, so an agent cannot corrupt plan state by editing prose.

validation.notes: Transitions enforce legal status moves; render reflects but does not drive status; target api/internal/plans.
